title: frame picker photo develop
description:
RAW-11 Frame Picker: pick the frame the transport is on and develop
it as a photo, either with the clip's current grade or as a fresh,
separate photo develop.

UI: the clip-info sheet gains a Develop frame row opening a
ModalBottomSheet with the 1-based frame number and timecode
(tabular numerals) and two actions — Photo: use clip grade and
Photo: separate develop. Each enqueues a job through the existing
serial export queue.

Export pipeline: Target.PHOTO joins the dispatch when, the
output-name/display-name extension whens (png), and the three
MediaPublish placement whens (images collection, Pictures/
ritiMCRAW, image/png). ExportJob carries frameIndex (0-based,
the clip's own frame numbering; defaulted at the end so existing
rows parse unchanged, persisted omit-when-zero, preserved across
requeue/retry via copy()).

PhotoExporter: opens the clip on the shared export engine thread,
dev
